outcome: microbial invasion of the amniotic cavity (MIAC)
cohort: The study included 528 pregnancies complicated by preterm prelabor rupture of membranes.
finding: No association was identified between the birth weight of newborns and the presence of intra-amniotic inflammatory and infection-related complications in pregnancies with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes.
birth_weight: Birth weights were measured and expressed as percentiles derived from INTERGROWTH-21st standards for newborn birth weight and estimated fetal weight.
gest_age: The study included pregnancies with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes, indicating preterm gestational ages.
